description:
Get full details of a Spark asset by its slug — description, metadata, outcome
reports, bundled files and the URL on spark.entire.vc.

Takes a slug, for example from a search result, a popular list or a link. Returns
the full picture of the asset. It does not return the prompt/skill/agent text
itself; get_asset_content returns that.
name: get_asset
title: Get asset details
